This is a classic construction of the "Cantor's Teepee" or the "Knaster-Kuratowski Fan".
The standard construction of the Knaster-Kuratowski fan involves a Cantor set $C$ and a point $p$ above it. The space consists of segments connecting $p$ to points in $C$, but only certain points on those segments are kept.
